title: Mission 03: Breadcrumbs
story: Facilities lost the map of the new campus wing. You are the surveyor: walk the building, and at every waypoint drop a breadcrumb file containing your EXACT location. cd moves you; pwd never lies about where you are.

badge.name: Breadcrumbs: Surveyed
badge.desc: Mastered cd and pwd by surveying a deep directory campus with absolute, relative, home and symlink navigation.

tasks.brief: Read BRIEFING3.txt in your department directory. Then navigate all the way down to the server room: campus/$MISSION_WING-wing/floor2/suite_b/server_room. Once you are standing IN it, drop here.txt containing exactly the output of pwd.

checks.fail: here.txt does not exist in the server room yet.
here.txt must contain exactly the absolute path pwd prints while standing in the server room.

tasks.brief: From the server room, climb exactly two levels with ONE relative move (no absolute path, think dot-dot) and drop floor.txt there containing the output of pwd.

checks.fail: floor.txt does not exist two levels above the server room (that is the floor2 directory).
floor.txt must contain exactly the pwd output of the floor2 directory.

tasks.brief: Wherever you are, one short command takes you HOME. Go there and drop athome.txt containing the output of pwd.

checks.fail: athome.txt does not exist in your home directory yet.
athome.txt must contain exactly your home directory's absolute path as pwd prints it.

tasks.brief: The annex is NOT under your home at all: it lives at the absolute path /opt/campus/annex. Jump straight there with one absolute cd and drop annex.txt containing the output of pwd.

checks.fail: annex.txt does not exist in /opt/campus/annex yet.
annex.txt must contain exactly /opt/campus/annex as pwd prints it.

tasks.brief: Surveyors bounce between two sites constantly. Produce toggle.txt in your department directory with exactly two lines: line 1 = pwd output from the server room, line 2 = pwd output from the annex. cd has a one-character shortcut that flips you back to wherever you just were.

checks.fail: toggle.txt does not exist in your department directory yet. You can write a file into your department directory from anywhere: use the FULL absolute path after > (it starts with /home/student/), and >> to add the second line.
Line 1 of toggle.txt must be the server room's absolute path.
Line 2 of toggle.txt must be the annex's absolute path.
toggle.txt must be exactly two lines.

tasks.brief: Facilities installed a shortcut: campus/shortcut points at the server room. Enter THROUGH the shortcut, then produce truth.txt in your department directory with two lines: line 1 = where pwd SAYS you are (the shortcut path), line 2 = where you PHYSICALLY are (pwd has an option that resolves symlinks).

checks.fail: truth.txt does not exist in your department directory yet. If you wrote it with a relative path (../..) from inside the shortcut, it followed the PHYSICAL tree and landed elsewhere. Write it using the FULL absolute path to your department directory (it starts with /home/student/).
Line 1 must be the logical path pwd prints when you entered via the shortcut (the shortcut path itself).
Line 2 must be the PHYSICAL path with the symlink resolved (pwd's resolve option).
A surveyor leaves no stray breadcrumbs at the campus entrance.

tasks.brief: BONUS: standing in the server room, how many directories deep are you from the filesystem root / ? Count the components in pwd's output and write just that number to depth.txt in your department directory.

checks.fail: depth.txt must contain just the number of path components between / and the server room (count the slashes in pwd's output carefully: home, student, your department, campus, the wing, floor2, suite_b, server_room).
